notes.subject: היארי
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV fɔ 'chief minister' — כהן tun bɛ fɔ 'nɔgɔnya-mɔgɔ' la gɛlɛyɔrɔ la; masalan JPS ni BSB fɔ 'priest' de ye; Ira tun ye Dawid ka sarakalasebaga ye

notes.subject: ⟨ye⟩
notes.rationale: Bamanankan ka wale-daɲɛ 'ye … ye' bɛ Bamanankan na, Heburukan ma a sɔrɔ

notes.subject: Yayiri-taden
notes.rationale: היארי kɔrɔ ye 'Yayiri den' ye — tɔgɔ-famuden; a tɛ 'Yayiri ka ba ye'

translation: Ira (Ira), Yayiri-taden (Yayiri den), ye Dawid (Dawuda) sarakalasebaga ⟨ye⟩.
